name: Bike drivetrain and groupset compatibility
description: Which bicycle drivetrain components work together, from the manufacturers' own compatibility documents: which cassette fits which driver body or freehub spline, which chain, derailleur and crankset belong to the same system, and what spacer or adapter a cross-generation pairing needs. Answers 'will cassette X fit freehub Y' and 'is derailleur A compatible with cassette B' — questions assistants answer by analogy across generations that the manufacturers explicitly forbid.
licence: factual compilation from manufacturer technical documents; facts cited with attributed quotes, no document reproduced
